body_sentences: I am near the front door at home.
My school bag is under the small table.
Two books are in the bag.
I can bring a bag to school.
paragraph: First, I am Tom. I am near the front door at home. My school bag is under the small table. Two books are in the bag. The bag is for school. School is my next place. I can bring a bag to school. My hands are free.

game_projection.instruction_zh_tw: 閱讀 Tom 的短文，然後在房間裡找到 school bag。
